summary: All four deferred issues are implemented exactly as planned. #379: duration heuristic replaced by a duration-independent flock liveness check (.build.lock held across the whole base build; age-free reaper via _claude_base_staging_build_is_live); _STALE_STAGING_MAX_AGE_SECONDS and `import time` removed, `import fcntl` added. #381: _prepare_claude_overlay_mount returns the 4-tuple (merged, upper, work, base) at all return sites; _reconcile_fallback_edits_into_upper applies the generation/mtime rule (fallback edit iff base absent or legacy mtime > base; copy only when upper absent or legacy strictly newer — upper wins ties) and is invoked before rmtree(legacy); the transient-fallback regression test is preserved unchanged. #382: st_ctime_ns added to both root and walk signature entries with the documented design-call docstring; the pre-pin revert recovery test is replaced by pin-based test_pinned_upper_recovers_across_host_metadata_change. #389: new module gc_claude_base.py with reap_superseded_claude_bases, protected set (current signature, live-mounted lowerdir bases via new iter_overlay_lowerdirs, pinned bases), hard-guarded rmtree under base_root, three reason codes (and a NOOP), and partial-on-permission-denied; wired host-wide through run_service_workspace_gc behind claude_base_gc_enabled (default True, acts only under execute), threaded into WorkspaceGCResult.to_dict, route passes host_home + flag. All planned tests exist, including defensive-branch coverage (outside-root refusal, non-permission OSError, unreadable/empty marker, missing auth root, lowerdir outside root, iter_overlay_lowerdirs missing/optionless). Non-goals honored (no content hashing, no teardown change, no removal of live/pinned/current bases). REASON_CATALOG.md and openapi.json correctly require no regeneration: the GC-B codes are local report strings (not registered doctor _REASON_TEXT entries) and ServiceGCResponse carries claude_base_reap via extra=allow with no new typed field.
